Figure 3 Overview of SeVeR. Multi-modal 3D volumes are first encoded into dense tokens via a shared 3D ViT. The Greedy Prototype Selector (GPS) distills redundant tokens into compact prototypes using global affinity to preserve broad visual coverage. Change-aware Gated Attention (CaGA) dynamically injects multi-level features from a bank during decoding, using language-conditioned decoder states to retrieve complementary evidence.
